author: ED CARSON
title: Dow Jones Futures Rebound Strongly On China News; Two Big Stock Market Rally Catalysts On Tap | Investor's Business Daily

organizations.name: china news spurs global stock market rebound
dow jones futures today dow jones

text:
Dow Jones futures soared Friday morning, along with S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq futures, amid a flurry of positive China news and ahead of the December jobs report and comments from Fed Chairman Jerome Powell. In Thursday's stock market , the Dow Jones tumbled 2.8%, the S&P 500 index 2.5% and the Nasdaq composite 3%. Warnings from Apple ( AAPL ) and Delta Air Lines ( DAL ) and a big drop in a key manufacturing gauge triggered the selling. Apple stock and Delta stock dived, while iPhone suppliers and other airline stocks sold off. The 2019 stock market rally attempt is still on. But for now it's still a stock market correction.
X Dow Jones Futures Today Dow Jones futures were 1.25% above fair value. S&P 500 futures climbed 1.3%. Nasdaq 100 futures jumped 1.7%. Remember that overnight action in Dow futures and elsewhere doesn't necessarily translate into actual trading in the next regular stock market session. However, Dow Jones futures did signal the sharp Apple-led sell-off Thursday.
China News Spurs Global Stock Market Rebound A trio of positive China news headlines spurred a global stock market rebound. First the Caixin service-sector purchasers index came in stronger than expected. Second, China's central bank slashed bank reserve requirements by 100 basis points to support more lending and economic growth. That came after Premier Li Keqiang visited several Chinese banking giants and pledged support for the economy. Third, China confirmed U.S.-China trade talks will take place in Beijing on Jan. 7-8.
All this came after the Caixin factory gauge this week signaled contraction for the first time in nearly two years. And, of course, Apple became the latest notable company to warn citing China weakness .
Concerns over the Chinese economy and the U.S.-China trade war have been among the biggest head winds for the stock market rally.
The Shanghai composite, which is in a long bear market, rose 2.05% on Friday. European stocks markets also traded solidly higher.

Aside from a three-day uptrend in mid-October, the Nasdaq has had three stock market rally attempts. In late October to early November, the Nasdaq trended higher over seven sessions. From late November to early December, the Nasdaq moved up over eight days. In both cases they were capped by a follow-through day , confirming the new market rally. Confirmed market rallies sometimes fail, and when they do it's usually soon evident. The Nasdaq immediately turned south in both instances, hitting new lows, entering a bear market in late December.
After the meltdown into Christmas Eve, the Nasdaq composite shot up 5.8% on Dec. 26. The Nasdaq extended its win streak to five sessions. Then came Thursday's sharp stock market sell-off, led by Apple stock, Delta stock and many others. Apple is a member of the Dow Jones, S&P 500 index and Nasdaq composite.
Until the market confirms a clear, positive direction, investors should stay on the sidelines. The stock market could head lower again. But when there is a confirmed stock market rally, be ready to act, but don't act rashly.
Stock Market Catalysts Friday In addition to China news headlines overnight, the U.S. jobs report and comments from Fed Chairman Powell will be closely watched Friday morning. Bulls would like to see strong job growth as a sign of a healthy economy, followed by Fed Chairman Powell taking a more dovish tone on the economy, stock market and Fed policy.
